mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to recover from its recent trough, commuting-linked foot traffic will rebuild spending trips and push RETAIL_REC above the prior four-week average within four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying above its t-0w level or rising further.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly decline in PARKS below the prior week reduces outdoor leisure substitution, shifting weekend visits back to malls and restaurants and lifting RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: After a week in which PARKS drops by more than 10 points, RETAIL_REC does not rise within the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains deeply depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, discretionary outings are constrained and the retail channel stays below the previous month’s level over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -20 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT remains below -20 and RESIDENTIAL remains above +10 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GROCERY_PHARM indicates more essential errand travel that spills over into nearby shopping trips, raising RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM moves up for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES falls again while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, people substitute toward home-based routines and reduce discretionary retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC lower within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES drops below -15 while RESIDENTIAL stays above +10
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days after WORKPLACES falls below -15 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +10.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lag rebound in PARKS after a prior collapse signals weather normalization, which restores leisure outings and lifts retail-and-recreation mobility within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 15 points from its prior week after being negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines within 14 days even though PARKS rebounds by at least 15 points from a negative reading.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a simultaneous drop in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES suppresses spontaneous shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC falls below its recent four-week mean over the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both trend downward for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 28 days despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES declining for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued easing in TRANSIT combined with stable or rising GROCERY_PHARM reflects broader trip recovery, which should lift RETAIL_REC within one week through spillover spending on the same outings.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stops falling and moves up week-on-week while GROCERY_PHARM is non-decreasing
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 7 days after TRANSIT turns up and GROCERY_PHARM does not decline.
